direction: Grand and powerful, slow, deep and resonant, like the narrator of a legend or a great battle.
text: Inside the oldest mountain in the world, there is a door. And it opens for only one thing: seven words.

direction: Low, slow and tense, holding back a secret, with dramatic pauses.
text: On a stormy night, in the village of Brightwater, a boy called Sami found a torn map under his grandfather's bed.

direction: A soft, close whisper, slow and secretive.
text: Seven words open the door. Find them before the dragon wakes.

direction: Shocked and amazed, gasping at the start.
text: A dragon? Grandpa, is this real?

direction: Gentle and loving, soft and close, like talking to a child at bedtime.
text: As real as the rain on that window, Sami. And now the map has chosen you.

direction: Calm, warm and unhurried.
text: The first word. Quest. A long, hard journey to find something important.

direction: Grand and powerful, slow, deep and resonant, like the narrator of a legend or a great battle.
text: And so the quest began. Sami packed bread, a lamp, and the map, and he walked into the dark.

direction: Low, slow and tense, holding back a secret, with dramatic pauses.
text: But someone was following him. And the second word would need a valiant heart.

direction: Happy and warm, smiling while speaking, light and bright.
text: Before you go. What is a quest? Write your answer in the comments.

direction: Low, slow and tense, holding back a secret, with dramatic pauses.
text: Someone was following Sami. And the second word was waiting on the most dangerous bridge in the kingdom.

direction: Terrified and breathless, almost whispering, slow, as if something is right behind you.
text: Who's there? I have a lamp, and I'm not afraid!

direction: Happy and warm, smiling while speaking, light and bright.
text: Calm down! It's only me, Lina. Grandpa sent me. He said you would need help.

direction: Low, slow and tense, holding back a secret, with dramatic pauses.
text: On the bridge, old letters were carved into the stone. Only the valiant may cross. Say the word, and the bridge will hold.

direction: Calm, warm and unhurried.
text: Valiant. Very brave, especially when you are in danger.

direction: Grand and powerful, slow, deep and resonant, like the narrator of a legend or a great battle.
text: Sami took a deep breath, held Lina's hand, and shouted the word into the wind. Valiant!

direction: Low, slow and tense, holding back a secret, with dramatic pauses.
text: The bridge held. But far behind them, in the mountain, something very old opened one eye.

direction: Happy and warm, smiling while speaking, light and bright.
text: Your turn. Which word means very brave? Tell me in the comments, and I'll see you in episode three.

direction: Low, slow and tense, holding back a secret, with dramatic pauses.
text: Some forests forget. This one remembered everything, and it did not like strangers.

direction: Terrified and breathless, almost whispering, slow, as if something is right behind you.
text: Sami, the trees are moving. I'm sure they're moving.

direction: A soft, close whisper, slow and secretive.
text: Don't stop walking, Lina. Grandpa said the third word sleeps in the oldest tree.

direction: Low, slow and tense, holding back a secret, with dramatic pauses.
text: On the oldest tree, the bark had words. I was here before the kings. I am older than the rain.

direction: Calm, warm and unhurried.
text: Ancient. Very, very old. Older than anyone can remember.

direction: Grand and powerful, slow, deep and resonant, like the narrator of a legend or a great battle.
text: Sami put his hand on the tree and said the word. Ancient. And the forest let them pass.

direction: Low, slow and tense, holding back a secret, with dramatic pauses.
text: But behind them, a man in a grey cloak picked up a fallen leaf, and smiled.

direction: Happy and warm, smiling while speaking, light and bright.
text: Your turn. Which word means very, very old? See you in episode four.

direction: Low, slow and tense, holding back a secret, with dramatic pauses.
text: The fourth word was on the other side of a river that no boat had ever crossed. Until that night.

direction: Happy and warm, smiling while speaking, light and bright.
text: You want to cross my river? Ha! Children always do. And they always come back wet.

direction: Quiet, heartbroken and tender, slow, with a soft breaking voice.
text: Please, ma'am. We need the fourth word. Someone is following us.

direction: Low, slow and tense, holding back a secret, with dramatic pauses.
text: The old ferry woman wrote on her paddle. The river is perilous. Only those who say so may cross.

direction: Calm, warm and unhurried.
text: Perilous. Very dangerous. A perilous road, a perilous sea.

direction: Grand and powerful, slow, deep and resonant, like the narrator of a legend or a great battle.
text: Perilous, said Sami. The water went still, like glass, and the little boat carried them across.

direction: Terrified and breathless, almost whispering, slow, as if something is right behind you.
text: But under the glass, something long and dark swam slowly after them.

direction: Happy and warm, smiling while speaking, light and bright.
text: Your turn. Which word means very dangerous? Episode five is coming.

direction: Low, slow and tense, holding back a secret, with dramatic pauses.
text: For four nights, the man in the grey cloak had followed them. On the fifth night, he spoke.

direction: Angry and sharp, firm, controlled fury.
text: Give me the map, boy. Your grandfather stole it from me, fifty years ago.

direction: Angry and sharp, firm, controlled fury.
text: That's not true! My grandpa never stole anything!

direction: Bursting with excitement and surprise, energetic, faster.
text: Run, Sami! I'll stay. I won't leave you, but I won't let him take it either!

direction: Gentle and loving, soft and close, like talking to a child at bedtime.
text: Loyal. Always on your side. A loyal friend never leaves you.

direction: Grand and powerful, slow, deep and resonant, like the narrator of a legend or a great battle.
text: Lina stood between Sami and the stranger. And the map glowed, and wrote a new word. Loyal.

direction: Shocked and amazed, gasping at the start.
text: The stranger stepped back into the dark. And Sami saw his face. It looked just like Grandpa.

direction: Happy and warm, smiling while speaking, light and bright.
text: Your turn. A friend who never leaves you is… what? Episode six is next.

direction: Low, slow and tense, holding back a secret, with dramatic pauses.
text: The sixth word was not hidden. It was asked. And whoever answered wrong would forget their own name.

direction: A soft, close whisper, slow and secretive.
text: Sami, the stranger looks like your grandpa. Do you think they're brothers?

direction: Quiet, heartbroken and tender, slow, with a soft breaking voice.
text: I don't know. But I know Grandpa. He would tell me the truth.

direction: Low, slow and tense, holding back a secret, with dramatic pauses.
text: Then the lake spoke. What grows when you share it, and is lost when you hide it?

direction: Calm, warm and unhurried.
text: Wisdom. Knowing what is true, and what is right to do. Wisdom grows when you share it.

direction: Grand and powerful, slow, deep and resonant, like the narrator of a legend or a great battle.
text: Wisdom, said Lina and Sami together. The lake opened like a door, and showed them the mountain.

direction: Low, slow and tense, holding back a secret, with dramatic pauses.
text: Six words. One left. And the dragon was waking up.

direction: Happy and warm, smiling while speaking, light and bright.
text: Your turn. What grows when you share it? The final episode is next.

direction: Grand and powerful, slow, deep and resonant, like the narrator of a legend or a great battle.
text: Seven nights. Six words. And now, at last, the door in the mountain.

direction: Gentle and loving, soft and close, like talking to a child at bedtime.
text: You came. Good. I was the one who drew that map, Sami. I'm your grandfather's brother.

direction: Quiet, heartbroken and tender, slow, with a soft breaking voice.
text: Then why did you follow us? Why did you scare us?

direction: Calm, warm and unhurried.
text: Because the last word cannot be taken. It can only be found, after a long, perilous road.

direction: Gentle and loving, soft and close, like talking to a child at bedtime.
text: Hope. Believing that something good will happen, even in the dark.

direction: Grand and powerful, slow, deep and resonant, like the narrator of a legend or a great battle.
text: Quest. Valiant. Ancient. Perilous. Loyal. Wisdom. Hope. The door opened. And the dragon opened both its eyes.

direction: Happy and warm, smiling while speaking, light and bright.
text: But the dragon did not roar. It smiled. It had waited a hundred years for someone to say those seven words.

direction: Happy and warm, smiling while speaking, light and bright.
text: Final test. Can you remember all seven words? Write them in the comments.
